title: Grand Theft Auto V
japaneseTitle: グランド・セフト・オートV
composer: Tangerine Dream, Woody Jackson, The Alchemist, Oh No
shortDescription: Rockstar's record-shattering open-world phenomenon featuring the three-protagonist heist narrative of Michael, Franklin, and Trevor.
historicalSignificance: The most profitable entertainment product in human history, generating over $1 billion in its first three days and selling over 190 million copies, pioneered seamless mid-mission character switching between three protagonists.

editorialContent.overview: Developed by Rockstar North and launched in September 2013, Grand Theft Auto V pushed the seventh generation consoles to their absolute graphical and computational limits. Set in contemporary Southern California (Los Santos and Blaine County), the game introduced a revolutionary tripartite narrative following retired bank robber Michael De Santa, ambitious repo street hustler Franklin Clinton, and psychotic desert maniac Trevor Philips.
editorialContent.gameplay: Players switch instantaneously between the three protagonists with a cinematic camera zoom-out/zoom-in. The campaign structure centers on complex multi-phase Heists requiring planning (stealth vs. loud approach), crew recruitment, and synchronization during execution. Outside missions, Los Santos offers tennis, golf, stock market manipulation on BAWSAQ, deep-sea diving, and stunt flight.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Rockstar created a dynamic procedural score by Tangerine Dream and Woody Jackson that responded to driving intensity and police wanted levels, paired with groundbreaking water physics and immense draw distances.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: GTA V shattered every entertainment sales record in history ($800M on day one; $1B in 72 hours). Its multiplayer counterpart, GTA Online, became an unprecedented multi-billion-dollar live-service phenomenon spanning three console generations.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved across three console generations (PS3/360, PS4/X1, PS5/Series X) and continuous modern PC updates on Rockstar Games Launcher and Steam.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 190 million copies worldwide (second best-selling video game of all time)
awards: Game of the Year 2013 (Golden Joystick Awards, GameTrailers)

technicalSpecs.engine: Rockstar Advanced Game Engine (RAGE) with custom lighting and Euphoria physics
technicalSpecs.soundChip: Dolby Digital 5.1 with Tangerine Dream / Woody Jackson dynamic score
